model.id: {next} is not {previous}.
The lock belongs to another model; it is not a successor of the previous one.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses the change against the previous lock, and in the error of opening with a lock the database refuses against the one it was last opened with: the next lock is of another lineage. `next` and `previous` are the model ids.
